profile.description: Bank Nizwa SAOG provides commercial banking products and services to individuals, small and medium size enterprises, corporations, and government institutions. It operates through three segments: Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, and Treasury and Investment Banking. The company offers personal banking products and services, including current, savings, Mudaraba investment, youth, minors, ladies banking, and recurring deposit accounts; personal, auto, home, and commercial finance for individuals, as well as sustainable finance, buyout, and Iskan programmes; debit and credit cards; and wealth management services, as well as letters of credit, long term financing, and foreign exchange services. It also provides project finance and syndication, SME and commercial banking, corporate call account and internet banking, and trade finance; and government, investment, and international banking products and services. In addition, the company offers current, checking, call, and term investment accounts. It serves customers through various channels, including branches and ATMs, digital and online banking. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
